title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Stone
overview: Before the events of Bakemonogatari, Koyomi and Tsubasa delve into the  mystery surrounding a stone that was enshrined into one of the school's  gardens.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Flower
overview: After Hitagi's condition is treated, she and Koyomi investigate the true  reason why some flowers were left behind on a street and the school's  rooftop.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Sand
overview: After Oshino leaves the city, Mayoi informs Koyomi about a sand box  whose shape resembles a devil and he decides to find out why.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Water
overview: After Koyomi helps Kanbaru tidying her room, he has a bath in her house,  and finds out a curious story about the water of the tub.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Wind
overview: Nadeko comes over to Koyomi's house, and is pleasantly surprised that  Koyomi's parents and siblings are all absent. The two then engage in a  discussion about Kaiki's curse and his means of spreading the rumor  amongst the middle schoolers in town.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Tree
overview: Karen asked Koyomi for advice regarding a mysterious grown tree that suddenly appeared on her dojo's backyard.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Tea
overview: Tsukihi consults Koyomi regarding her Tea Club members on why her fellow  members still believe in the ghostly "eight member" despite Tsukihi  proving the rumor was fake.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Mountain
overview: As Ougi and Koyomi climb the mountain where the North White Snake Shrine is located, she tells him that the shrine was moved there from another mountain.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Torus
overview: When Koyomi gets donuts from Hitagi, Shinobu tries to eat all of the donuts.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Seed
overview: On his way home, Araragi sees Yotsugi, who asks him for help finding something.

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Nothing
overview: When Koyomi asks Yozuru Kagenui about the extent of her relationship with Yotsugi, she challenges him to a fight. But then Yozuru disappears...

title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Dead
overview: On Exam day, Koyomi visits the North White Snake shrine to look for Kozuru. Instead he sees Izuko Gaen there.
